title: Customer Data Controls Intake: Prioritization Canvas and SLA Routing
creator: Marco Chen
description: Develop a reproducible intake and prioritization canvas for customer requests related to logging redaction, retention, PII handling, and audit exports. The canvas should produce a numeric score used to route requests to the appropriate response path (self-serve playbook, Solutions Engineering, Dedicated support, or Legal/Privacy). Deliverables: scoring rubric, triage automation spec, sample response templates, and monitoring SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Scoring rubric documented with examples for at least 20 request archetypes. 2) Automated routing rules described and executable by Customer Support runbooks. 3) Response templates for self-serve and escalated tracks written and approved by Privacy and Legal. 4) Dashboard showing intake volume, median decision time, and SLA attainment per track.
tasks: Interview top 10 enterprise customers about expectations and constraints
Inventory current support tickets and tag historical cases with proposed score fields
Draft scoring rubric and run a calibration session with Privacy/Legal/SEs
Define automation rules and required webhook payloads for Support tooling
Author response templates and Q/A scripts for Support
Design intake dashboard metrics and wireframes
Pilot the canvas on a 2-week internal sample set and iterate
